Atlantis Physical Therapy has been your neighbor in the South Bay since 1981. Our experience in rehabilitation has helped thousands of local residents recover from a long list of orthopedic and neurological problems. Returning patients to their life pursuits is a personal goal for us and a source of great satisfaction for our entire staff. 

Specialties Include:
Orthopedic & Sports Injury Rehab
Pre & Post Surgical Rehab
Senior Fitness
Brain Health & Fitness
Neuro Rehabilitation
Balance, Gait & Posture Training
Senior Cognitive Training
Osteoporosis Management
Vestibular/Vertigo/Dizziness
TMJ
Cranio-Sacral Therapy
Hand/Wrist/Upper Extremity Therapy
Work Injury Management
Functional Capacity Evaluation
